notes: ACCESS: horchow.com is fully retired - EVERY path on the domain (homepage, /robots.txt, /christmas, and an arbitrary nonexistent path all tested) 301/302s to the single fixed URL https://www.neimanmarcus.com/c/home-all-home-cat59040731?fromhc=true. This matches the prior Home Decor extraction's documented finding (pipeline/json_archive/c35.json, c242.json): Horchow's catalogue is now entirely the Neiman Marcus 'All Home' department, with no Horchow-specific scoping surviving the redirect. Direct HTTP fetch (curl/curl_cffi chrome-impersonation) and headless Playwright were both hard-blocked by DataDome (interstitial/captcha) on every URL including robots.txt; Claude-in-Chrome (real browser session) loaded all pages normally. robots.txt (fetched via Claude-in-Chrome once past DataDome) carries no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow, only routine crawl exclusions (account, login, staging, etc.) - proceeded under standing browser-access rules. TAXONOMY: the All Home department's own left-nav Category facet lists three seasonal nodes - Fall & Thanksgiving, Christmas, Hanukkah - alongside non-seasonal department nodes (Home Decor, Furniture, Kitchen, Bedding, Lighting, Rugs, Bath & Towels, Luggage & Travel, Storage & Organization, Outdoor, Tech & Games, Home Gifts, Gourmet Food & Treats). QTY METHOD: same-origin fetch() of each canonical /c/... URL from within the live browser session, reading the SSR-embedded productListPage 'total' field immediately following the product array; cross-verified against the rendered 'N items' header on the Christmas page itself (both read 984) before trusting the method for the rest. CHRISTMAS (984 items, cat82900738): kept as a grouping row - its own left-nav exposes 8 further nodes. 'Christmas Decor' (975) is itself a further grouping row with 4 real theme-filtered children (Classic/Gold & Silver/Colorful Christmas, Christmas Traditions summing to only 484, i.e. partial curated cuts, not a full partition - parent kept null per project convention, not double-counted). Leaf siblings under Christmas: Ornaments & Tree Decor 487, Stockings & Tree Skirts 83, Wreaths Garlands & Ribbons 185, Christmas Trees 23, Holiday Entertaining 225 (verified Christmas-exclusive - 0 occurrences on the Hanukkah or Fall & Thanksgiving pages, despite its generic-sounding name), Advent Calendars 5. EXCLUDED: 'Gourmet Food & Treats' (cat40350757, 206 items) appears in the Christmas left-nav but is confirmed to be the exact same top-level generic department node also listed directly under 'All Home' (23 raw occurrences of its cat ID on the All Home page) - not a Christmas-specific listing, so per seasonal rules SS5/SS6 it was excluded as a generic category merely cross-linked into Christmas's nav, not a genuine seasonal category. HANUKKAH (71 items, cat83270767) and FALL & THANKSGIVING (217 items, cat82900737) are both flat leaf categories - visiting each shows no further nested sub-category facet (left-nav reverts to the department-level list), so each is emitted as a single leaf row named after the holiday itself. No Halloween, Easter, Valentine's, Diwali, or other holiday nodes exist anywhere in this department's taxonomy - checked the full left-nav Category list on all three seasonal pages, none present. No Indian-festival or other-language seasonal terms apply (USA site, English only). All links are canonical neimanmarcus.com PLP URLs, consistent with the c35/c242 precedent for this company.
